_readme: Brand profile for Audiogram Maker v1.2. One file per brand. Keys starting with _ are notes and are ignored. Paths are relative to this file. The values below ARE the approved default look; brand-from-url, brand-from-logo and the host-photo fallback only fill in brand_name, brand_mark, colors.accent, colors.primary and spelling.
_brand_mark: A square-ish logo or the brand's X profile picture. It is the FIRST photo of the footer Hosts row, shown as given (never recolored). It must read on the dark style. Leave empty to start the row with the Space hosts.

logo._note: style none (default): no logo in the top bar; the Space title is on the left and 'X Space · date' on the right. wordmark / icon / text put a logo back in the top bar only if the user asks. Logos are never recolored: dark_mode / light_mode other than original are ignored. mark (background watermark) is off by default.

colors._note: accent: the brand colour, used ONLY for highlights (current word underline, accent words, progress bar). primary: a deeper brand colour for highlights in the light style. Backgrounds, glow and frame line stay neutral for every brand.

font._note: Leave file empty to use Inter. A brand font must be a file the user has the right to use.

footer._note: The footer is a centered Hosts row: round photos with name and handle, brand mark first, then the Space hosts (filled by init from the Space). link / promo_code / button_text appear only if the user gives them. footer_text is only used when there are no hosts at all.

captions._note: 84 px, weight 650, sentence case (never all caps), at most 2 lines. highlight: underline (default), color or both.

clip._note: payoff: the last sentence becomes the large centered payoff line (per clip override: clips.<id>.payoff). tail_pad_s: the end always sits this long after the last word. No intro, fade in or fade out, ever.
